items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And the saxophones was Procope and Johnny and Harry and Jimmy Hamilton, and Sears was still there.

ctx.x: A quiet guy, very nice guy. I have a picture of him -- sometime I'll show you -- at home.
And the trombones was Tyree and Lawrence Brown and myself. And the saxophones was Procope and Johnny and Harry and Jimmy Hamilton, and Sears was still there.
